title: Watts vs. Bytes: Turning Data Centers into Grid Assets via Storage Compute Co-Optimization
summary: Data center interconnections increasingly face tighter peak-demand and ramp-rate limits while being expected to support grid operations. Satisfying these requirements calls for coordinated computing and energy controls, yet their joint operational and economic implications remain poorly understood. To tackle this problem, we formulate a robust day-ahead co-optimization of computing load scheduling, server dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS), and co-located battery energy storage system (BESS) dispatch.
